about.title: Licensed, local, and accountable for the whole job.
about.lead: Majesta Renovations inc is a residential and commercial renovation contractor based in Saint-Laurent, Montreal.
about.body1: We hold RBQ licence 5870-0170-01, which covers all thirteen of the service categories listed on this site — from a single bathroom to a full home addition with plans. Because the licence covers the electrical and plumbing scope on kitchen, bathroom and basement work, you are not left coordinating separate trades yourself.
about.body2: We work across the whole island: Montreal Centre, East, North, the West Island and the South. Calls and quote requests are answered in one to two hours. Across 23 reviews, our rating stands at 5.0.
